verdict.rationale: Apify's docs say Actor results are stored in datasets that can be exported as JSON, as well as CSV, XLSX or XML (apify-docs-32). The API clients document running an Actor and retrieving its result items programmatically, including pagination and loading items into Pandas (apify-docs-16, apify-docs-24, apify-docs-28, apify-docs-26). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the JSON item structure and schema, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the JSON output.
